verdict.rationale: v0 documents a dedicated Platform API for programmatic access to code generation, chat interface, project management, and deployment, and ships an official SDK (v0-sdk) with working code examples (chats.create, streaming reads) that demonstrate real programmatic app generation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the API in production use and more detail on programmatic 'management' operations (listing/updating/deleting apps) beyond chat/project creation.
